title: Gowramma
desc: Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.

title: Chandu
desc: Chandu, a college student, beats up a gangster for his unjust acts. Fearing the wrath of the gangster, his parents send him to Bengaluru, where he meets the love of his life.

title: Badava Rascal
desc: Shankar, a young man, is kidnapped by a gang of thugs. In order to escape his predicament, he narrates his life story to make his abductors rethink their decision.

title: Aajay
desc: Ajay, a kabaddi player, hides Padma from Veerabhadra, a gangster who wants to force her into marrying him. Soon, the two fall in love.
